resources.string: Paste C codes and quantities, or read C codes, quantities and location IDs from XLSX.
Enter one C code and quantity per line, separated by spaces, commas or tabs. Text uses the location below. Quantities for the same code and location are combined. Review before confirming inbound.
C code and quantity (one pair per line)

Reads the first visible worksheet: column 1 C code, column 2 quantity, column 3 existing location code (blank uses the selected location). Headers and blank rows are supported; up to 500 rows and 10 MiB. Quantities must be positive integers. Overlapping codes and locations require an explicit replace or append choice.
Processed %1$d items; skipped %2$d already committed receipts.
Could not read the import. Check the file and its format.

These codes and locations already exist in this draft. Replace uses the incoming quantities instead of the overlapping draft rows; append keeps those rows and adds the full incoming quantities. Other rows are kept. Cancel makes no changes.
Some overlapping rows are already committed. Replacement is unavailable; appending adds more stock after review. To correct existing stock, cancel and use inventory adjustment.
